correctness.rationale: For every integer r>=2, binary MSD transitions (u,v,e)->(v+ez,u,z) calculate the number of pair-11 digits from the right; 1100 and 0110 independently increment the two residue coordinates when e=0, all 2r^2 states are reached, and suffixes 00(1100)^t, 00(0110)^t0, and a phase-triggering 1 separate every pair. LSD completed-pair/pending-bit transitions reach 3r states; suffixes (11)^t and 1(11)^t force inconsistent congruences for different phases, and other pairs have direct selectors. Base4 r-state minimization is elementary. The standalone checker independently minimizes all three explicit automata for r=2..9 and compares all outputs with direct counts for n<512 and four padding choices; this finite test is not an infinite proof.

The uniform all-moduli result exhibits a sharp family-wide 2r^2 versus 3r reading-order gap and exact r-state base-four optimum, supplying a motivated infinite classification and minimal automata rather than a tiny table.
